data.one_liner: Adds a separate stream for one-time events in Bloc/Cubit
data.what_it_does: It extends Bloc/Cubit to expose a dedicated stream for side effects, such as navigation or snackbars. The UI listens to this stream instead of state changes, preventing re-triggering on rebuilds.
avoid_when: when all events can be represented as state changes
when you need persistent state updates
weaknesses: adds extra mixin or base class boilerplate
